title: CPCSC Level 1 user identity and re-authentication need scoped verification
remediation: The sponsor identity owner maps in-scope user identities to accounts and processes acting on their behalf, with approved re-authentication triggers. Review the effective identity configuration and retain a dated test of unique identification, process attribution and re-authentication when an approved trigger occurs. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the approved identity and process mapping, authentication settings and redacted identification and re-authentication results
